name: icu localeCompare default and locale argument
source: function main(): void { console.log("a".localeCompare("B"), "B".localeCompare("a"), "a".localeCompare("a"), "ä".localeCompare("z", "de"), "ä".localeCompare("z", "sv"), "résumé".localeCompare("resume", "fr")); console.log(["b","A","a","B","ä","z","Z"].sort((x, y) => x.localeCompare(y, "en")).join(",")); }
